Ben Burgess appoints Ben B Turner as new managing director

3 hrs ago
By Chris Hill Agricultural editor

Share

0 comments

New chapter for farm machinery firm as boss proudly hands over the reins to his son

Norfolk-based agricultural dealer Ben Burgess has appointed Ben B Turner (right) as its new managing director - taking over from his father Ben Turner, who becomes chairman (Image: Ben Burgess)

Skip to next photo

Norfolk-based agricultural dealer Ben Burgess has appointed Ben B Turner (right) as its new managing director - taking over from his father Ben Turner, who becomes chairman (Image: Ben Burgess)

A 95-year-old Norfolk farm machinery business has begun an "exciting new chapter" as the leadership of the family firm was handed down to the next generation.

Norwich-based agricultural dealer Ben Burgess has appointed Ben B Turner as its new managing director.

He takes over the reins from his father Ben Turner, the grandson of the company's namesake Ben Burgess, who founded the firm in 1931.

Ben Turner (right) pictured with his grandfather Ben Burgess when he succeeded him as managing director of the family firm 32 years ago (Image: Ben Burgess)

During the last 95 years, the family has guided the growth of the business into a leading agricultural dealer across the Eastern counties.

Ben B Turner said: "Stepping into the role of managing director is a great honour.

"I have seen my great-grandfather and father put their heart and soul into the business, building relationships on handshakes, trust and a shared passion for genuine customer service.

"To lead the board and to do so with my father continuing to guide our operations is a privilege."

After starting his career as an apprentice, Ben Turner has dedicated more than 48 years to the company, including 32 as managing director. He said the time was right to hand over the baton.

He said: "It’s been great to watch my son grow as a leader and now to be guiding the company’s future.

"Our business has always been about family, our customers and the land we all rely on.

"The time is right and I’m incredibly proud to pass the managing director’s seat to Ben B, as my grandfather did for me 32 years ago.

"Moving into the role as chair allows me to return to what I enjoy most - working directly with our team, our partners and customers, who are the backbone of our community."

The firm's board of directors expressed their "thanks to Ben for his visionary leadership over the decades, and to warmly welcome and congratulate Ben B into his new role".

They added: "Ben B has the vision, drive, experience and commitment to lead Ben Burgess.

"Together, father and son look forward to entering this exciting next chapter, ensuring that Ben Burgess remains a trusted partner to generations to come and continuing to build on the family value 'where service still counts.'"

Read More:

  • Planners approve changes to plans set for former 'first of its kind' clinic site

Ben B Turner began his career with machine manufacturer John Deere UK, later managing product pricing in Germany.

He returned to the UK after five years to join Ben Burgess as group John Deere sales and marketing manager, then leading the Groundscare department before becoming a director in June 2019.
